note: What a client sends while a match loads, saying how far it has got. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: playerId
fields.note: Who is reporting. Observed as every bit set, which names nobody.

fields.name: percent
fields.note: How far loading has got, from zero to one hundred.

fields.name: eta
fields.note: How long the client expects still to take, in seconds.

bits.name: count
bits.note: How many reports have been made.

bits.name: ping
bits.note: Round trip time the client measures, in milliseconds.

bits.name: loaded
bits.note: Set only in reports whose progress stands at one hundred, and in all but the first few of those.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. A client leaves these as it found them, so they carry values it never wrote for this message.
